tasks.title: Capture the existing boot graph and inclusion provenance
tasks.goal: Expose actual source/contribution/occurrence structure without replacing compiler IR.
steps: Extract shared semantic graph construction from CLI-local summaries using existing compiler/observer data.
Retain repeated occurrences, inclusion chains, source positions and exact capture/snapshot identities.
Separate reading retained traces from live capture; missing/evicted/unreadable data is explicit, not silently recomputed.
positive_cases: Repeated contribution has distinct occurrences linked to one logical source.
Selecting a fragment reveals the exact why-included chain.
negative_cases: Map collapse cannot hide repeated inclusion; unchecked refs cannot be labelled unresolved.
Retained inspection cannot acquire a trace writer or rerun providers.
acceptance: Full authorized child traversal reconstructs the captured graph.
Provenance previously available only as text is structured.
tasks.safe_stop: Publish current captured graph with honest mapping gaps; no canonical rewrite.
notes: Internal children execute sequentially; cross-parent prerequisites remain exactly the root campaign graph.

tasks.title: Calculate exact and qualified boot measurements
tasks.goal: Measure content and occurrences without imposing a token quota.
steps: Measure raw/emitted bytes, scalar counts, unique payload and actual read occurrences from the captured graph.
Add tokenizer identity/version with exact/estimated/unavailable status; show unknown ambient tail separately.
Report direct/inclusive contribution only where mapping proves it; large captures use streaming/chunking rather than total-size rejection.
positive_cases: Same capture and tokenizer recipe yields reproducible counts.
Repeated reads differ from unique payload size.
negative_cases: Missing mapping cannot be replaced by proportional fake attribution.
No size/token threshold may veto install/build or pretend to be provider billing.
acceptance: Measurement report names basis, recipe and unknown portions.
Large corpus can be traversed without hidden total boot cap.
tasks.safe_stop: Keep unavailable token/attribution values explicit; never guess a budget verdict.
